description: List the documents in the user's Phở account that read_document can read: files read earlier through this tool and files the user uploaded on pho.chat (in a chat or a project). Use it when the user refers to a file they have ("my thesis", "the report I uploaded") or when the assistant cannot pass an attached file on: the user uploads it on pho.chat, then it shows up here. Needs a Phở sign-in.
